response.justification: While the candidate demonstrates strong seniority and solid software engineering fundamentals spanning 17+ years, there is a critical domain mismatch. The role requires deep expertise in embedded systems, C programming for firmware, Linux kernel work, and networking/security protocols (MACsec, 802.1X, etc.)—areas entirely absent from this candidate's web/mobile-focused background. Most critically, the candidate does not demonstrate the required native-level Japanese language proficiency. The extensive retraining needed across embedded systems, firmware, security, and networking protocols makes this unsuitable.
strengths: Extensive seniority with proven staff-level positions and ability to architect complex systems across multiple domains
Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies and languages; DLang experience shows some systems-level programming exposure
Strong DevOps and infrastructure background (Docker, CI/CD, GitLab) with low-latency optimization experience at Dunnhumby
concerns: No evidence of native-level Japanese language proficiency; resume lists only English (fluent), Romanian (fluent), and German (basic)
Entire career trajectory focused on web, mobile, and data platforms with zero demonstrated experience in embedded systems, firmware, or networking protocols

No C programming proficiency for embedded systems, no Linux kernel analysis experience, and no background in security technologies (encryption, authentication systems, MACsec) or network switch architecture
